run_extract_posed_images: run the script to extract posed RGB-D images from ScanNet .sens files into a usable dataset format
process_scene_SensorData: process a single ScanNet scene to extract depth images, color images, poses, and camera intrinsics
load_RGBDFrame: load a single RGB-D frame from a binary .sens file handle including camera pose and compressed image data
decompress_depth_RGBDFrame: decompress zlib-compressed depth data from an RGBDFrame into raw uint16 depth image bytes
export_poses_SensorData: export camera-to-world pose matrices for all frames in a ScanNet scene to individual text files
